name: .NET Full Stack Development (ASP.NET Core, Angular or React, SQL Server and Azure)

beginner.summary: For freshers and developers joining .NET project teams. Covers the full stack toolchain, C# and LINQ for application code, HTML, CSS and Bootstrap, JavaScript and TypeScript, SQL Server design for a project, an ASP.NET Core Web API with controllers, EF Core data access, DTOs and validation, an Angular client with routing, reactive forms and HttpClient, Identity and JWT login, role-based access, file handling, paging and search, logging, testing, React as an alternative client and deployment to Azure.
prerequisites: Knows programming basics in any language
Understands what a database table is
A laptop that can run Visual Studio or VS Code with the .NET SDK
outcomes: Build a complete business application with ASP.NET Core, EF Core, SQL Server and Angular
Secure the application with Identity, JWT and roles
Test, log and troubleshoot across the stack

days.topic: .NET Full Stack Overview and Developer Setup
subtopics: What a .NET full stack developer builds
How Angular, ASP.NET Core and SQL Server fit together
Installing the .NET SDK and checking versions
Visual Studio, VS Code and Rider
SQL Server Developer Edition or LocalDB and SSMS
Git and the solution folder layout
Postman or the HTTP files feature for API calls
Running the API and client together
The course project: a clinic appointment system

days.deliverable: Running solution skeleton in a Git repository
checks: Swagger page opens for the template API
Angular app opens and calls the template API
objectives: Explain the parts of a .NET full stack application

async and await in web applications

days.deliverable: Domain model library with unit tests

No nullable warnings in the library
Exception raised with a clear message

days.topic: HTML, CSS and Bootstrap for .NET Developers

CSS selectors, box model and Flexbox

No serious accessibility issues on the form

Promises and async/await in the browser

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Clinic Appointment System
days.lab_task: Complete the clinic system with patients, doctors, bookings, roles, documents, search, logging, tests and an Azure deployment, then demo it to a mock client.

intermediate.summary: For .NET developers who have built and deployed a full stack application. Covers solution layout across API, domain, infrastructure and client, advanced EF Core for business apps, CQRS with MediatR, client state with signals and NgRx, SignalR, Hangfire and hosted services, reports and exports, Redis and output caching, Entra ID sign-in, API versioning and generated clients, integration and end-to-end testing, performance tuning, OWASP risks, Docker Compose, Azure DevOps pipelines, Azure services, Application Insights, multi-language apps and Blazor.
prerequisites: Has built an ASP.NET Core API with EF Core and an Angular or React client
Comfortable with C#, TypeScript and SQL
outcomes: Structure and build maintainable .NET full stack solutions
Add real-time, background, reporting and caching features
Secure, test and tune applications across tiers
Containerise, deploy and monitor applications on Azure

advanced.summary: For senior .NET full stack engineers and technical leads. Covers enterprise architecture, modular monoliths, splitting services with .NET Aspire and YARP, long-running workflows with sagas, multi-tenant SaaS on Azure SQL, Angular micro-frontends, zero-trust security, data architecture and reporting databases, Native AOT and start-up performance, Container Apps and AKS hosting, Bicep and Terraform, observability with OpenTelemetry, migration from Web Forms and AngularJS, testing strategy, AI features with Semantic Kernel, Azure cost optimisation, compliance, production troubleshooting and leadership.
prerequisites: Several years building .NET full stack applications in production
Strong ASP.NET Core, EF Core, SQL Server and Angular or React skills
Has deployed and operated apps on Azure
outcomes: Architect enterprise and multi-tenant .NET full stack platforms
Scale, secure and observe every tier on Azure
Make and defend technical decisions for .NET teams
